summary: This Form 8-K discloses that Kingfish Holding Corp will hold its 2026 annual meeting on June 1, 2026, with a record date of April 30, 2026. Stockholders will vote to elect eight directors and ratify the auditor. The company is not subject to proxy rules under Section 14(a) of the Exchange Act. No sale, merger, or special-situation transaction is announced; this is an informational filing about a routine annual meeting.
